WITH trans_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    transref, 
    AVG(anlycount) as trans_avg
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  WHERE anlycount IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY transref
),
overall_avg_calc AS (
  SELECT AVG(trans_avg) as overall_avg
  FROM trans_avgs
),
kept_trans AS (
  SELECT ta.transref, ta.trans_avg
  FROM trans_avgs ta
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg_calc
  WHERE ta.trans_avg > overall_avg_calc.overall_avg
),
kept_avg_calc AS (
  SELECT AVG(trans_avg) as kept_avg
  FROM kept_trans
),
result_set AS (
  SELECT 
    kt.transref,
    kt.trans_avg as avg_anlycount,
    kt.trans_avg - oac.overall_avg as above_overall,
    kt.trans_avg - kac.kept_avg as above_kept,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY kt.trans_avg - kac.kept_avg DESC) as row_num
  FROM kept_trans kt
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg_calc oac
  CROSS JOIN kept_avg_calc kac
),
tenth_row AS (
  SELECT above_kept FROM result_set WHERE row_num = 10
)
SELECT 
  transref,
  avg_anlycount,
  above_overall,
  above_kept
FROM result_set
WHERE row_num <= 10 
   OR above_kept = (SELECT above_kept FROM tenth_row)
ORDER BY above_kept DESC
